statement_summary: One written program for both entities that meets the Safeguards Rule
Qualified Individual designated in writing; President of Title and Closing oversees quarterly
Intercompany agreement requires the parent to keep a compliant program, report, notify, and allow audit
Risk acceptance authority by level; no funds-diversion risk accepted above Moderate
Annual written risk assessment with SP 800-30 and after major changes
Annual written report to the board of managers and the audit committee; quarterly reporting
Annual policy review; written, risk-rated, time-limited exceptions
Sanctions for employees (HR) and contractor agents (Broker of Record)
No customer information to a service provider without a tiered review and security terms; Tier 1 reassessed yearly
Annual training for employees and agents; phishing simulations; role-based payment fraud training
Independent annual assessment; annual penetration test and six-monthly vulnerability assessments
Five-year retention of security records
Secure development standard for the portal; change management for production and SaaS settings
AI tools approved through AI governance before use
regulatory_driver: N53-R02 (15 U.S.C. 45(a)); Fair Housing Act (42 U.S.C. 3604)

statement_summary: Unique accounts; approved kiosk logins only
Role-based least privilege; transaction-level visibility in SYS-01; export rights for named roles
MFA for every individual including contractor agents; security keys for administrators and payment staff
Same-day disable at employee termination; bank tokens revoked the same day
Agent departures disabled within 1 business day; weekly license roster match; 90-day inactivity rule
Prior-role access removed within 5 business days of transfer
Quarterly access reviews by managers, managing brokers, and system owners
Separate privileged accounts; just-in-time elevation; no more than 4 standing global administrators
Sign-in lockout and device screen lock
Break-glass accounts for the identity provider, cloud, and SYS-02, tested quarterly
14-character passwords; banned list; service secrets in the key vault rotated yearly
Personal devices: browser-only on laptops, managed apps on phones
Named vendor and developer accounts with MFA; company approver for portal deployments
Portal users authenticated by one-time code; callback before any phone number change
Every employee and agent reports suspected incidents and suspicious payment instructions the same day
Incident commander declares and sets severity; possible funds diversion or data acquisition is Severity 1
Incident log records time of discovery and date of determination
Bank recall requested within 1 hour; pending payments to the affected payee held
Decision log for every Severity 1 incident (acquisition presumption, counts, states, decisions)
All notices follow the P08 matrix and are approved by General Counsel
Out-of-band communication during email compromise or ransomware
Ransom decision needs CEO, counsel, insurer, and an OFAC sanctions check
Monitoring of identity, email, cloud, endpoint, and SaaS application events per STD-02
Annual tabletop for each P08 runbook; quarterly verification of bank and insurer contacts
Lessons learned within 14 days, documented within 30 days
Restore in BIA order and validate before reconnection
Highest data class recorded per system; Restricted data inventories kept current
Encrypt Restricted data in transit and at rest; compensating controls only with Qualified Individual approval
Wire instructions only through the Closing Communications Portal
Callback and two-person rule for every payee or bank account change in any system
Payoffs only from the lender portal or confirmed by callback to a published number
Retention schedule; customer information disposed of within two years of last use unless a documented reason applies
Disposal makes information unreadable; certificates kept; consumer reports included
Paper with Restricted data locked and moved to headquarters within 30 days of closing
No Restricted data in unapproved AI tools; no-training terms
Company systems for company business; limited personal use
No account or MFA sharing; no approving unexpected MFA prompts
No forwarding rules to outside accounts; external auto-forwarding blocked
Never send, forward, or confirm wire instructions by email, text, or chat
Personal device rules for agents and employees
Report suspicious messages, prompts, lost devices, and payment change requests at once
Clean desk for Restricted paper
Approved AI tools only; fair housing review of AI-drafted ads; no unapproved scoring features
regulatory_driver: Fair Housing Act (42 U.S.C. 3604(c)); N53-R02 (15 U.S.C. 45(a))
